<div class="content__wrapper">
      <div class="grid__container"><h1>Swiss Kitesurf ♡ Lo Stagnone</h1></div>
<div class="inhalt__wrapper">
  <div class="grid__container">
    <div class="inhalt__text">
      <p><strong>Start your 2026 summer a little earlier with our kite camp in Sicily.</strong></p>
<p>Learn to kitesurf or push yourself to the next level with perfect conditions.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<article class="actionbanner__section">
    <section class="actionbanner__wrapper">
        <div class="col-2">
            &nbsp;
        </div>
        <div class="col-7">
            <div class="actionbanner__content" data-sal="slide-right" data-sal-duration="500" data-sal-easing="ease-in-out">
                <h3 class="actionbanner__title">When?</h3>
                <p class="actionbanner__text">10.04 - 17.04.2027 / 17.04 - 24.04.2027 / 24.04 - 01.05.2027 / 01.05 - 08.05.2027 / 08.05 - 15.05.2027 / 15.05- 22.05.2027</p>
            </div>
        </div>
                        <div class="col-3">
                <div class="actionbanner__button" data-sal="slide-left" data-sal-duration="500" data-sal-easing="ease-in-out">
                                        <a class="actionbanner__button--link" href="https://kitesailing.ch/en/kite-camp-booking-request" >
                        <span class="button button--invers button--small">Book now!<i class="icon-right-open"></i></span>
                    </a>
                </div>
            </div>
    </section>
</article>
<div class="inhalt__wrapper">
  <div class="grid__container">
    <div class="inhalt__text">
      <p>Learn to kitesurf or push yourself to the next level with perfect conditions.<strong><br /><br />This is what Sicily offers:</strong><br /><br />- Flat water spot with the largest standing water lagoon in Europe<br />- Perfect wind conditions<br />- Summer temperatures<br />- “la dolce vita” Italian lifestyle and, of course, Italian cuisine<br /><br />... so need we say more?<br /><br />✨ <strong>This is included:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Accommodation: </strong>7 nights, single or double room directly at the kite spot. From bed to board</li><li><strong>Meals:</strong> A delicious breakfast every morning at the accommodation</li><li><strong>Lessons/coaching:</strong> 6 days full package. Morning and afternoon lessons. Theory (with VDWS license), tips/tricks, video analysis and plenty of time on the water.</li><li><strong>Spot:</strong> Spot fee included. Use the large take-off and landing area directly at the lagoon and enjoy the magical sunset in the chill-out area with its cozy bar.</li><li><strong>Equipment:</strong> Level-adapted kite equipment for the best learning success. Learn to kitesurf or take yourself to the next level with our top equipment.</li><li><strong>Explore:</strong> If the wind takes a break, there is plenty to discover in the region. Whether it's a trip to Erice, a small Sicilian mountain village, a tasting tour of the various Sicilian wines by the lagoon amidst the vines or a guided tour of the Saline dello Stagnione.</li><li><strong>80% wind probability</strong></li><li><strong>Plenty of time to relax, sleep, eat and soak up the sun<strong><br /></strong></strong></li></ul>
<p>&#x1f32c;️ <strong>Great wind conditions &amp; amazing vibes guaranteed!</strong> Whether you're just starting or perfecting your tricks, we offer expert guidance in a relaxed, fun atmosphere. Freeriders are also welcome – bring your own gear or use ours!</p>
<p>✨<strong>Not included</strong><br /></p><ul><li>Flights and visa: You have to organize these yourself, but we will be happy to help you find the best options!</li><li>Transfer from Palermo airport to Birgi Vecchi: We can also help you with this and organize a transfer. It is best to book a rental car for your time in Sicily as they are quite cheap.</li></ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
  <article class="inhalt__element">
    <div class="grid__container">
      <div class="inhalt__wrapper--bild align--bildRechts bildgroesse-small">

            class="lazyload"

        </div>
          <div class="text__wrapper">
            <h3>For beginners or anyone who wants to improve their skills</h3>
            <p>&#x1f3c4;‍♀️ <strong>Lessons for All Levels:</strong></p>
<ul><li><strong>Accommodation, standard room with double bed, incl. breakfast</strong><br /> </li><li><strong>Beginners, intermediate, or advanced</strong> – we offer lessons for all experience levels.</li><li><strong>Semi-private lessons (2-1)</strong>: Get tailored instruction focused on your personal progression.</li>
<li><strong>5 x </strong><strong>3 hours lessons per day</strong> in <strong>German or English</strong>.</li>
<li>Once you’re independent, you can use the equipment at any time!</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>CHF 1700.-</strong></p>
<p>If you come as a couple or as a pair, overnight stay in a standard room double bed.<strong><br />Price per person: CHF 1400.-</strong></p>
          </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid__container">
      <div class="inhalt__wrapper--bild align--bildRechts bildgroesse-small">
        <div class="bild__wrapper">
          <img
      data-srcset="
          https://kitesailing.ch/assets/img/teambilder/_600xAUTO_crop_bottom-right_80_none/72375/7B5A0786_2025-08-01-141456_bytx.jpg 600w,          https://kitesailing.ch/assets/img/teambilder/_1200xAUTO_crop_bottom-right_80_none/72375/7B5A0786_2025-08-01-141456_bytx.jpg 1200w        "
      data-src="https://kitesailing.ch/assets/img/teambilder/_600xAUTO_crop_bottom-right_80_none/72375/7B5A0786_2025-08-01-141456_bytx.jpg"
              alt="7 B5 A0786"
            class="lazyload"
    />
        </div>
          <div class="text__wrapper">
            <h3>The entertainer</h3>
            <p>Meet Michi, our all-rounder and entertainer &#x1f3a4;!</p>
<p>He knows Lo Stagnone like a local and often says that if Silvaplana didn't exist, he'd happily spend all his days kiting in Sicily. And trust us—his infectious energy will have you smiling from morning until well into the evening. &#x1f604;</p>
<p>Whether he's teaching a group, spreading good vibes around the beach, or simply making sure everyone is having a great time, Michi has a special talent for making every moment more memorable and relaxed.</p>
<p>But he's not just the life of the party—Michi is also an outstanding kiter &#x1f3c4;‍♂️. From your very first water start to advanced tricks and techniques, he's got the experience, patience, and enthusiasm to help you progress while making every session as fun as possible. &#x1f30a;</p>
          </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </article>
  <article class="inhalt__element">
    <div class="grid__container">
      <div class="inhalt__wrapper--bild align-- bildgroesse-small">
        <div class="bild__wrapper">
          <img
      data-srcset="
          https://kitesailing.ch/assets/img/teambilder/_600xAUTO_crop_bottom-right_80_none/80371/Wes-Profil-bild.jpg 600w,          https://kitesailing.ch/assets/img/teambilder/_1200xAUTO_crop_bottom-right_80_none/80371/Wes-Profil-bild.jpg 1200w        "
      data-src="https://kitesailing.ch/assets/img/teambilder/_600xAUTO_crop_bottom-right_80_none/80371/Wes-Profil-bild.jpg"
              alt="Wes Profil bild"
            class="lazyload"
    />
        </div>
          <div class="text__wrapper">
            <h3>The DJ</h3>
            <p>And this is Wes, Michi's sidekick... or maybe it's the other way around... Either way, they're an unbeatable team, bringing good vibes, plenty of laughs, and unforgettable sessions from sunrise to sunset. &#x1f604;</p>
<p>Wes kites like a god, has both the best and the worst sense of humor, and somehow also finds time to be an incredible DJ. &#x1f3a7; With what feels like a million years of teaching experience at kite spots all over the world, he has an amazing ability to break down even the most challenging skills into simple, confidence-building steps.</p>
<p>Whether you're taking your very first lesson, working on your upwind riding, or chasing your first jumps, Wes knows exactly when to push you, when to slow things down, and how to help you progress quickly—all while making sure you leave the water with a huge smile on your face. &#x1fa81; If there's one thing he loves as much as kiting itself, it's seeing his students nail their next milestone. &#x1f30a;</p>
          </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </article>
<div class="inhalt__wrapper">
  <div class="grid__container">
    <div class="inhalt__text">
      <p><strong>IMPORTANT!!!</strong><br /><br />In order for a camp to take place, we need a <strong>minimum of 3 students</strong>. We will only confirm the camp once the minimum number of participants has registered.<strong><br /><br />Please do not book flights before we have confirmed the camp!</strong><br /><br /><strong><br />Current status:</strong><strong><br /></strong></p>
